osmium.name: Osmium
osmium.description: Densest optimization. Zero stutter. Maximum FPS.
osmium.command.help.stats: §e/osmium stats §7- View memory, GC, frame times, and cache statistics
osmium.command.help.target: §e/osmium target <fps> §7- Set target FPS budget for frame throttling

osmium.command.help.pools: §e/osmium pools §7- View object pool hit/miss metrics
osmium.command.help.offheap: §e/osmium offheap §7- View off-heap memory cache metrics

osmium.config.title: Osmium Configuration
osmium.config.enabled.tooltip: Enable or disable all Osmium optimizations.
osmium.config.dynamicResolutionEnabled.t: Dynamically scales rendering resolution when frame times exceed budget.
The lowest scale factor DRS will decrease to (0.5 to 1.0).
osmium.config.targetFps.tooltip: Frame rate target used by the frame budget controller.
osmium.config.offHeapCacheMb.tooltip: Native memory allocated for chunk payloads outside JVM garbage collection.
osmium.config.chunkLRUCacheSize.tooltip: Maximum number of chunk objects cached in heap memory before offloading.
osmium.config.hierarchicalZCullingEnable: Cull hidden entities and block entities using a downsampled depth mirror.
Interception and depth reuse for Iris shader pipelines.
osmium.config.objectPoolingEnabled.toolt: Thread-safe pooling for BlockPos, Box, and Vec3d instances.
osmium.config.predictiveChunkLoadingEnab: Prioritize chunk requests ahead of player velocity vector.
osmium.config.simdEnabled.tooltip: Vector API acceleration for coordinate and vertex math (requires JVM flag).
osmium.config.debugStats.tooltip: Show verbose performance logs in console.
osmium.config.temporalBlendWeight.toolti: Weight factor for blending historical reprojected frames.
